nodes.label: A `#### event data` JSON dump is what stops a labelled event section from being labelled but empty
nodes.rationale: The stated reason the JSON dump is kept: without it a section counts as labelled while carrying nothing readable. [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-10-02 - t6-markdown-renderer [ses_f05f0d546ffeuPIj1K4UPMhp71].md:L7701] Three layers per event: the label, scalar-field bullets, and a `#### event data` JSON dump — the dump is what makes "labelled" not mean "labelled but empty", and it covers `compaction.summary`/`synthetic.text` prose too. Unknown types fall through the same path, so a future schema addition degrades to a labelled section instead of silence.
